data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. Positive reviews are detailed, span many years, and mention specific staff and communication methods. Negative reviews are also detailed and credible, describing specific failures and financial losses. The Yelp rating is lower, which is common as the platform often attracts more critical reviews. The most significant pattern is a credible complaint about taking money without fixing a problem, and concerns about service decline after a merger.

negative_evidence: Paid $1152 over two months, problem never fixed
Charged for parts without resolving issue

authentic_signals: Specific project and problem details (DE filter, specific charges)
Varied writing styles and timeframes (reviews span 7 years)
Mix of praise and specific complaints
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
complaint_patterns: Failure to fix problems after payment
data.discrepancy_explanation: Moderate discrepancy between Google (4.7) and Yelp (3.7). This is not extreme but suggests Yelp reviewers may be more critical or the sample is different. BBB has no rating, so no conflict there.

reviews.text: After 4+ years with another pool servicing company, I realized that I needed better results. After 1 month with Pool Referees I'm extremely happy with their service. My pool looks great. The techs are very thorough, and the company has been very communicative and responsive to my questions.
reviews.author: Tim Whiteman

reviews.text: I paid this company $1152 to fix my filter over two months and they never fixed the problem. I had to call another company to fix it because the filter would dump all the DE power back into the pool. They came to my house several times over two months guessing as to what was wrong and charging to replace all kinds of parts. The owner even told me that it's hard to find good employees that know all the equipment of a pool, and yet they are so shameless to take the job. If you want to WASTE your money, please call them. They have NO shame, no professionalism, and will gladly steal from you two.
reviews.author: Fray Rod

reviews.text:
Pool Referee has done an amazing job for us over the last several years. Their communication is spot on and they will always let us know if there’s a delay in our pool service.
Their technicians do a great job, and we’ve rarely had anything to contact them about. I highly recommend them, and would recommend them to any of my closest friends and family.
reviews.author: leona gunnels

reviews.text: They were great until they merged with gold medal pools. I’ve had a service request since Monday for an urgent issue and nobody has come out to fix it. I’ve called twice and was reassured it was high priority with the freeze and it is still unresolved. When this company was owned by pool refs they were great. Sad to see a family owned company go down after merging.
reviews.author: Angela Pampolina

reviews.text: I'm a first time pool owner with no prior experience.  I am so grateful to have found Pool Referees! They are honestly the best pool company to have. I contacted Pool Referees out of desperation. My prior pool company had not return my calls in regards to my pool emergency. So, I reached out to pool referees and I'm so glad I did. For their first visit Robert came out to measured my pool and took pictures of my equipment. Which really came in handy when I needed someone to help me drain my pool. He sent me step my step instructions and a picture of the valve I needed to use. My pool stays sparkling blue everyday even up to the next visit. Which is something that wasn't happening with the other company. I highly recommend Pool Referees. Don't waste your time and money with any other company.
reviews.author: Yousef Alkhatib

reviews.text: There have been some minor problems but overall this is a very, very good company.  They are generally attentive to my requests and concerns.  Also, they always give you a reminder that they will be servicing the pool on the next day.  As a general rule, the pool is pristine when they leave.
reviews.author: Barry

reviews.text: Can't say enough great things about this company.  Refreshing to finally find a pool service company that is focused on quality and customer service.  So far Robert and Daniel were the two Ive interacted with, but the support staff when calling in are super helpful  and friendly as well.  This company is highly efficient, cost is more than reasonable, and quality is top notch.  I would recommend to anyone looking for exceptional pool service.
reviews.author: Ryan Eubanks

reviews.text: The Pool Refs have been taking care of my pool for more than 2 years, and it is always ready for a swim. Their techs are friendly and professional, and I really like the way they communicate via notes, email and texts. I always know when the pool has been serviced and the work that was done.
reviews.author: Tom Coleman
